_note: Commit-vs-found DROP sweep: scale-free edgesPerNode=3 (mean degree ~6), UNLIMITED capacity, 50 queries, N=100, depth D=6, consensus ON, NO refusers. Sweeps conditions.dropFraction - the fraction of links (not incident to a sleeping/late node) that drop every delivery. Unlike refuserFraction, a dropped link degrades BOTH phases through the one shared per-link conditions map: it severs some discovery routes (liftCount falls below 50) AND, where discovery peer-matched a dark terminus or crossed a now-dropped needed edge, the consensus record push over that link is lost and the lift STALLS (pending, voidReasons.stalled) because v1 has no propagation timeout. So pCommitGivenFound = commitCount/liftCount falls for a second reason beyond fewer routes: found-but-unsettlable lifts. No latency is set, so codes never expire (see ../README.md on the 600000ms code TTL ceiling). Question: as links drop, how do found-count, commit-rate and stalls move together? See ../README.md and packages/tallysim/docs/design.md.
